projects.title: Aluminum Head — Faceted Metal Sculpture
projects.subtitle: Form-finding, sheet fabrication and assembly
projects.summary: The faceted aluminum head photographed in the workshop, with related triangular panel prototypes and folded-metal assemblies. This project shows geometric decomposition translated into a physical sculptural form.
projects.caveat: The sculptural head and related triangular fabrications are grouped visually; verify the precise role, credits and whether all shop prototypes belong to the same commission.

projects.title: Thermoformed Corian Fin Wall
projects.subtitle: Curved fins, forming jigs and completed interior
projects.summary: A study of flowing fin geometry in Corian solid surface, from shop-cut components and forming fixtures to wavelike installed fins. Fabrication and installation details are kept together to show how a computational surface becomes buildable.
projects.credit: Alireza Memarian · Work at MAK Studio
projects.caveat: Corian thermoforming and MAK Studio are confirmed by the portfolio owner. Check whether all dark-fin close-ups are the same commission and add client/collaborator credits.

projects.title: Austin Tessellated Installation
projects.subtitle: Triangulated structural and faceted wall geometry
projects.summary: Tessellated geometry developed through triangulated shop mockups, nested fabrication parts, timber framing, and finished faceted architectural surfaces. The project series is identified as Austin work by the portfolio owner.
projects.caveat: The triangular shop work and installed cladding have been grouped visually; confirm which individual images share the same Austin project.

projects.title: Interactive Outdoor Public Art
projects.subtitle: Built freestanding patterned installation
projects.summary: Photographs of a freestanding outdoor patterned artwork at installation, after completion, and at night. The steel or aluminum detailing and exact venue are not established by the filenames.
projects.caveat: Confirm title, exact metal/material, site, role, and participating artists before presenting this as a named commission.

projects.title: Perforated Metal Portrait Artwork
projects.subtitle: Image as perforation, fabrication and exhibition
projects.summary: Close views and exhibition photographs of a perforated portrait panel, using controlled open area and light to reproduce an image in a physical surface.
projects.caveat: The face is part of the artwork, not a personal portrait photograph. Confirm the panel material, title, collaborators and exact role.

projects.title: CNC-Patterned Feature Wall
projects.subtitle: Design diagrams, carved panel texture and built interiors
projects.summary: A coordinated series of MAK Studio design diagrams and installed carved-pattern wall photographs, showing milled texture, curved cutouts, modular surface construction and spatial detail.
projects.credit: Alireza Memarian · Work at MAK Studio
projects.caveat: Project and studio grouping is supported by the filenames, but individual contribution and collaboration credits require review.
